page.overview:
Who is Kallohan?

Kallohan has Piccolo's cold demeanor and Gohan's kind heart.

Kallohan is an S-Rank fighter born from the EX-Fusion two A-Rank fighters (the Super Namekian fusion Piccolo and half-Earthling/half-Saiyan Gohan) who have strong affinity due to being master and student which results in a massive power-up. Additionally, Kallohan inherits Piccolo's Namekian body allowing him to regenerate and extend his arms. He also inherits Gohan's vast latent potential and Piccolo's vast combat experience due to his past life as King Piccolo along with the knowledge he gained from his fusions with Nail and Kami.
